learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and understanding of the engineering disciplines specific to their specialty, at the level necessary to acquire the rest of the degree competencies, including notions of the latest advances.
Be aware of the multidisciplinary context of engineering.

Ability to project, design and develop complex products (parts, components, finished products, etc.), processes and systems of their specialty, that meet the established requirements, including being aware of social, health and safety, environmental, economic and industrial aspects; as well as selecting and applying appropriate project methods.

Ability to perform bibliographic searches, consult and critically use databases and other information sources, to carry out simulation and analysis with the objective of conducting research on technical topics of their specialty.
Ability to effectively communicate information, ideas, problems and solutions in the field of engineering and with society in general.
Ability to function effectively in national and international contexts, individually and in teams, and to cooperate with engineers as well as with people from other disciplines.
Ability to recognize the need for their own continuous training and to undertake this activity throughout their professional life independently.
Ability to stay up to date with new developments in science and technology.

Communicates, searches and structures information correctly orally: Makes a clear and concise oral presentation and defense of the project, adequately using the aspects included in the oral communication guide and the IT tools.

teaching_methods: Development, drafting, and presentation of reports, memorandums, audiovisual material, etc. related to projects/POPBLs, performed individually or in teams
Individual study and work, tests, exams and/or control points
Lecturer presentations in the classroom, in participatory classes, of concepts and procedures associated with the subjects
Visits to laboratories, companies and/or CCTT

assessment_methods.method: Reports on exercises, case studies, computer practices, simulation practices, and laboratory practices
Technical capacity, involvement in the project/PBL, work performed, results obtained, documentation submitted, technical presentation and defense
Observation of student participation and attitude in proposed training activities
Individual written and oral tests for the evaluation of technical competencies of the subject

assessment_rules: The evaluation is continuous. For submitted work throughout the semester, there will be peer and lecturer evaluation and feedback, followed by submission of an improved version. For the semester project, the final document and presentation must incorporate recommendations received from experts and tutors. No specific mechanisms for recovery are mentioned for individual components.
